business_problem: Bede Gaming’s legacy database was costly, cloud-locked, and inflexible—limiting performance, portability, and scalability in a fast-paced, high-volume gaming environment.
solution_summary: Bede Gaming’s legacy database was costly, cloud-locked, and inflexible—limiting performance, portability, and scalability in a fast-paced, high-volume gaming environment. Migrating to MongoDB Atlas enabled cloud-agnostic deployment, enhanced portability, and cost-effective scalability with zero performance loss across high-volume workloads. It’s scalable, modular, and adaptable with open APIs, allowing operators to use its bespoke tools or to seamlessly integrate it with any third-party software. As a result, Bede Gaming has halved its data storage costs for the same workloads, with zero performance loss and enhanced data portability. “We wanted the ability to deploy in any cloud environment,” said Whiteley. Currently, the company runs MongoDB Atlas on Azure, but it has the option to be cloud-agnostic or completely self-host. “There's a high degree of flexibility with a tool like MongoDB,” adds Whitely.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Provides the managed document database backing Bede Gaming's modernized application platform.

data_flow: Operational data from legacy or distributed applications is consolidated in MongoDB Atlas, where flexible document models support microservices, APIs, and downstream user experiences without batch-heavy synchronization. Upstream and downstream integrations include AWS, Azure, APIs.
